# Airfoil fixture: naca2412_c60_s60.stl

## Description
A constant-section NACA 2412 wing: the standard NACA 4-digit section (thickness distribution applied perpendicular to the camber line, closed trailing edge, cosine-spaced points) extruded along +Z (span) at fixed chord 60 mm from Z=0 to Z=60 mm. Z is the spanwise axis, so the printed wing stands vertically on the build plate with the section horizontal, per the constitution's vertical-print orientation.

## Origin convention
The 2D section is generated in chord-fraction coordinates (chord along X, thickness/camber along Y), scaled by the chord length, then translated so its own X/Y bounding box is centred on X=0, Y=0 -- i.e. it is centred on its bounding box, not on the leading edge or the chord line. The leading edge is therefore *not* at X=0; the section's actual X/Y extent is reported below. The wing sits on the build plate at Z=0 (root) and extends to Z=60 mm (tip).

## Exact dimensions
- NACA designation: 2412 (m=0.02, p=0.4, t=0.12)
- Chord: 60 mm
- Span: 60 mm
- Section X extent: -30.001750 mm to 30.001750 mm
- Section Y extent: -3.647249 mm to 3.647249 mm
- Z extent: 0.0 mm to 60 mm (60 mm)
- Points per surface: 120 (cosine-spaced; shared leading- and trailing-edge vertices between upper and lower surfaces, so the closed section outline has 238 vertices)
- Section area / bounding-box area (fill ratio): 0.6725
- Triangles: 948 (476 side wall + 472 cap)
- Format: binary STL, deterministic fixed ASCII header, no timestamps

## Purpose
This is the M2 fixture: the first genuinely cambered, non-rectangular geometry in the test suite. Its section fill ratio (area / bounding-box area) is well below the M1 `RECTANGULARITY_MIN = 0.90` fence in `aircraft_core/validate.py` -- see the number above -- so the M1 validator refuses this fixture today. That refusal is correct M1 behaviour, not a bug: the bounding-box margin checks it guards would mis-validate a cambered section (docs/milestones/M02-constant-section-airfoil.md). This fixture exists to be measured against once M2 replaces those checks with a real chord axis and local thickness.

Generated by `python tools/make_fixtures.py airfoil --naca 2412 --chord 60 --span 60 --points 120`.
